input.subject: Re: Revision Request on Proof : Design for Kenda Foreman
input.body:
Hey Sasha,

The proof is complete. I've updated the mockup to show the item without drawstrings.
Please note that this change is only for the visual mockup; the actual production piece will include drawstrings.

Best,
Raymund

decision.reason: The subject names the unique non-deleted proof Design for Kenda Foreman (652188), which maps via deal_proofs row 452866 to non-deleted deal 396982. Its client 297125 is Kenda Foreman; the client/account lookup returned only this deal.

limitations: The exact incoming email and drawstring wording were not independently located. Matching is based on the supplied subject and verified proof-to-deal relationship.
Proof artist_name is Artist Pan, not Raymund; this does not verify the signed author. Author identity is not used as routing evidence.
No received timestamp or provider/thread identifier was supplied; this is a current-state lookup, not historical replay.
The verified deal has no rows in the queried Sasha communication history; no matching proof comments were returned.
Confidence describes routing evidence, not independent confirmation of proof completion or production details.

previous_decision_without_subject.reason: No distinguishing message, proof, order or deal link was verified from the provided body and sender.

subject_followup_evidence.sql: SELECT id,first_name,last_name,account_id,deleted_at FROM `user` WHERE first_name=%s AND last_name=%s
SELECT id,name,client_id,artist_id,artist_name,description,created_at,deleted_at FROM proof_request WHERE name LIKE %s
SELECT id,deal_id,subject,LEFT(body,3000) AS body,message_timestamp FROM `dev_sasha_operations_v3`.sasha_communication_history WHERE subject LIKE %s

SELECT dp.id AS mapping_id,dp.proof_id,dp.deal_id,dp.deleted_at AS mapping_deleted_at,d.title,d.client_id,d.account_id,d.stage,d.deleted_at AS deal_deleted_at FROM deal_proofs dp LEFT JOIN deals d ON d.id=dp.deal_id WHERE dp.proof_id=%s
SELECT id,title,client_id,account_id,stage,created_at,deleted_at FROM deals WHERE client_id=%s OR account_id=%s
SELECT id,comment_type,relevant_id,written_by,written_by_id,content,created_at,deleted_at FROM `comment` WHERE comment_type=%s AND relevant_id=%s ORDER BY id DESC
